traces.reason: Use existing real HTTP/worker context, Firestore/Gemini dependency spans and real original-request links for asynchronous research steps when context is available.

logs.reason: Emit sanitized research batch progress/failure counts and existing HTTP/worker diagnostics; never log customer questions, notes, contacts, vectors or model replies.

businessEvents.reason: Committed hygieneScans, assistantConversations and assistantRequests use atomic domain outboxes with bounded lifecycle counts; reporting settings use key-only ai.research audit events.

deploymentEvents.reason: Retain the standard version/commit/run deployment BizEvent, marker and independent OTLP receipt probes. HTTP acceptance is separate from tenant-query visibility.
